zh: 一个多月以后，刘不才重回上海，他的本事很大，为胡雪岩接眷，居然成功。可是，全家将到上海，胡雪岩反倒上了心事，就为借了『小房子』住在一起的阿巧，身分不明，难以处置，只好求救七姑奶奶。『七姐，你要替我出个主意；除你以外，我没有人好商量。』『那当然！小爷叔的事，我不能不管。不过，先要你自己定个宗旨。』问到胡雪岩对阿巧姐的态度，正是他的难题所在，惟有报以苦笑∶『七姐，全本西厢记，不都在你肚子里？』七姑奶奶对他们的情形，确是知之甚深，总括一句话∶表面看来，恩爱异常；暗地里隔着一道极深的鸿沟。一个虽倾心于胡雪岩，但宁可居于外室，不愿位列小星，因为她畏惮胡家人多，伺候老太太以外，还要执礼于大妇，甚至看芙蓉的辞色；再有一种想法是∶出自两江总督行辕，虽非嫡室，等于『署理』过掌印夫人；不管再做什么人的侧室，都觉得是一种委屈。在胡雪岩，最大的顾虑亦正是为此。阿巧姐跟何桂清的姻缘，完全是自己一手促成；如今再接收过来，不管自己身受的感觉，还是想到旁人的批评，总有些不大对劲。在外面借『小房子』做露水夫妻，那是因为她千里相就于患难之中，因感生情，不能自己，无论对本身，对旁人，总还有句譬解的话好说；一旦接回家中，就无词自解了。
en: More than a month later, Liu Bucai returned to Shanghai. He had proved remarkably resourceful: his mission to bring out Hu Xueyan’s family had actually succeeded. Yet with the whole household about to arrive, Hu found himself burdened with a new worry. A’qiao was living with him in a rented “little house”, with no settled status. He did not know what to do about her and could only appeal to the Seventh Lady. “Seventh Sister, you must find a way for me. There is no one else I can consult.” “Naturally! I cannot refuse to concern myself with your affairs, Little Uncle. But first you must decide what you want.” His own attitude towards A’qiao was precisely the difficulty. He could only smile bitterly. “Seventh Sister, is not the whole Romance of the Western Chamber already in your head?” She did indeed know their situation thoroughly. In a word, they appeared devoted lovers, yet a deep gulf lay between them. A’qiao’s heart belonged to Hu, but she would rather remain his mistress outside the household than become a concubine within it. She dreaded the number of people in his family. Besides attending upon his mother, she would have to show deference to his principal wife and even watch Furong’s expressions for signs of favour or displeasure. There was another consideration. She had come from the governor-general of Liangjiang’s official residence. Though not his principal wife, she had virtually acted as mistress of his household. To become any other man’s concubine now seemed a descent. This was also the chief source of Hu’s misgivings. He himself had arranged her union with He Guiqing from beginning to end. To take her over now felt somehow improper, whether he considered his own feelings or other people’s criticism. Renting a “little house” and living as temporary lovers could at least be explained: she had travelled a thousand li to join him in adversity, and gratitude had awakened a love he could not resist. He could offer that excuse to himself and to others. Bringing her into his family would leave him without an answer.

zh: 除此以外，还有个极大的障碍；胡太太曾经斩钉截铁地表示过∶有出息的男人，三妻四妾，不足为奇；但大妇的名分，是他人夺不去的，所以只要胡雪岩看中了，娶回家则可，在外面另立门户则不可。同时她也表示过，凡是娶进门的，她必须姊妹看待。事实上对待芙蓉的态度，已经证明她言行如一；所以更显得她的脚步站得极隐，就连胡老太太亦不能不尊重她的话。然而这是两回事。七姑奶奶了解胡雪岩的苦衷，却不能替他决定态度，『小爷叔，你要我帮你的忙，先要你自己拿定主意，或留或去，定了宗旨，才好想办法。不过，』她很率直地说∶『我话要说在前头，不管怎么样，你要我帮着你瞒；那是办不到的。』有此表示，胡雪岩大失所望。他的希望，正就是想请七姑奶奶设法替他在妻子面前隐瞒；所以听得这句话，作声不得。
en: There was another formidable obstacle. Mrs Hu had stated her position with absolute firmness. A successful man might have several wives and concubines; that was nothing unusual. But no one could take away the standing of the principal wife. If Hu chose another woman, he might marry her and bring her home, but he must not establish a separate household outside. At the same time, she had promised to treat every woman he brought home as a sister. Her conduct towards Furong had already proved that she kept her word. This made her position all the stronger; even Hu’s mother had to respect it. But understanding Hu’s predicament and deciding his course were two different things. The Seventh Lady could do the first, not the second. “If you want my help, Little Uncle, you must first make up your own mind. Will you keep her or part from her? Once your purpose is settled, we can find a way. But I must tell you plainly beforehand: whatever happens, I cannot help you conceal it.” Hu was bitterly disappointed. Concealing the affair from his wife was exactly what he had hoped she would help him do. He could find nothing to say.

zh: 这一下，等于心思完全显露，七姑奶奶便劝他∶『小爷叔，家和万事兴！婶娘贤慧能干，是你大大的一个帮手。不过我再说一句∶婶娘也很厉害，你千万别惹她恨你。如果说，你想拿阿巧姐接回去，我哪怕跑断腿，说破嘴，也替你去劝她。当然，成功不成功，不敢保险。倘或你下个决断，预备各奔东西，那包在我身上，你跟她好合好散，决不伤你们的和气。』『那，你倒说给我听听，怎么样才能跟阿巧姐好合好散？』『现在还说不出，要等我去动脑筋，不过，这一层，我有把握。』胡雪岩想了好一会，委决不下，叹口气说∶『明天再说吧。』『小爷叔，你最好今天晚上细想一想，把主意拿定了它；如果预备接回家，我要早点替你安排。』七姑奶奶指一指外面说，『我要请刘三叔先在老太太跟婶娘面前，替你下一番功夫。胡雪岩一楞，是要下一番什么功夫？转个念头，才能领会，虽说自己妻子表示不禁良人纳妾；但却不能没有妒意。能与芙蓉相处得亲如姊妹，一方面是她本人有意要作个贤慧的榜样；一方面是芙蓉柔顺，甘于做小服低。这样因缘时会，两下凑成了一双两好的局面，是个异数；不能期望三妻四妾，人人如此。七姑奶奶要请刘不才去下一番功夫，自然是先作疏通；果然自己有心，而阿巧姐亦不反对正式『进门』，七姑奶奶的做法是必要的。不过胡雪岩也因此被提醒了；阿巧姐亦是极厉害的脚色，远非芙蓉可比。就算眼前一切顺利，阿巧姐改变初衷，妻子亦能克践诺言，然而好景决不会长，两『雌』相遇，互持不下，明争暗斗之下，掀起醋海的万丈波澜，那时候可真是『两妇之间难为夫』了。
en: His silence exposed his thoughts completely. The Seventh Lady advised him, “Little Uncle, harmony at home brings success in everything. Your wife is good and capable, a tremendous help to you. But let me add this: she is formidable too. You must never give her cause to hate you. If you want to bring A’qiao home, I shall wear out my legs and talk till my mouth is dry trying to persuade her. Of course, I cannot promise success. If you decide instead that you and A’qiao must go your separate ways, leave that to me. I can arrange a friendly parting without spoiling the affection between you.” “Then tell me how we could part on such terms.” “I cannot yet. I must give it some thought. But of that I am confident.” Hu thought for a long time without reaching a decision. “We shall talk tomorrow,” he sighed. “Think it over carefully tonight, Little Uncle, and make up your mind. If you mean to bring her home, I must begin preparing the way. I shall ask Third Uncle Liu”—she gestured outside—“to do some work with your mother and your wife beforehand.” Hu started. What sort of work? A moment’s reflection made it clear. Though his wife had said she would not forbid him to take concubines, that did not mean she felt no jealousy. Her sisterly affection for Furong arose partly from her determination to set a virtuous example, partly from Furong’s gentle willingness to accept a subordinate place. Their dispositions and circumstances had combined to produce an unusually happy arrangement. He could not expect every wife and concubine to behave so well. The Seventh Lady meant Liu to sound them out and smooth the way. If Hu truly wanted A’qiao at home, and A’qiao herself would agree to enter the household formally, such preparation was necessary. Yet this also reminded him how formidable A’qiao was—quite unlike Furong. Even if everything went smoothly at first, if she changed her mind and his wife kept her promise, the happy state would not last. Two strong women confronting one another would neither yield. Open quarrels and secret struggles would raise mountainous waves of jealousy. Then he would truly know how hard it was to be a husband caught between two wives.

zh: 这样一想，忧愁烦恼，同时并生；因而胃纳越发不佳。不过他一向不肯扫人的兴；见刘不才意兴甚好，也就打点精神相陪，谈到午夜方散。回到『小房子』，阿巧姐照例茶水点心，早有预备。卧室中重帷深垂，隔绝了料峭春寒；她只穿一件软缎夹袄，剪裁得非常贴身，越显得腰肢一捻，十分苗条。入手相握，才知她到底穿得太少了些∶『若要俏，冻得跳！』他说，『当心冻出病来。』阿巧姐笑笑不响，倒杯热茶摆在他面前，自己捧着一把灌满热茶的乾隆五彩的小茶壶，当做手炉取暖；双眼灼灼地望着，等他开口。每天回来，胡雪岩总要谈他在外面的情形，在哪里吃的饭；遇见了什么有趣的人；听到了哪些新闻，可是这天却一反常态，坐下来不作一声。『你累了是不是？』阿巧姐说，『早点上床吧！』『嗯，累了。』口中在答应她的话，眼睛却仍旧望着悬在天花板下，称为『保险灯』的煤油吊灯。这神思不属，无视眼前的态度，在阿巧姐的记忆中只有一次；就是得知王有龄殉节的那天晚上。
en: These reflections brought worry and vexation together, further spoiling his appetite. But he never liked to dampen another person’s pleasure. Liu was in excellent spirits, so Hu roused himself to keep him company, and they talked until midnight. When he returned to the “little house”, A’qiao had tea and refreshments ready as usual. Heavy curtains in the bedroom kept out the sharp chill of early spring. She wore only a lined jacket of soft satin, cut so close that her waist seemed slender enough to clasp in one hand. Taking her hand, Hu found that she really was too lightly dressed. “For the sake of looking pretty, you freeze till you jump! Mind you do not make yourself ill.” She smiled without answering. She poured him hot tea, then cradled a small teapot of Qianlong five-colour porcelain, filled with hot tea, to warm her hands like a hand stove. Her bright eyes watched him, waiting for him to speak. Every evening he would tell her what had happened outside—where he had eaten, what amusing people he had met, what news he had heard. Tonight, contrary to his habit, he sat without a word. “You are tired, are you not?” she said. “Go to bed early.” “Mm. Tired.” His mouth answered, but his eyes remained fixed on the hanging kerosene light beneath the ceiling, called a “safety lamp”. She remembered only one other occasion when he had been so absent-minded, so blind to what lay before him: the night he learnt that Wang Youling had died for his country.

zh: 『那哼啦！』她不知不觉地用极柔媚的苏白相依，『有啥心事？』『老太太要来了！』关于接眷的事，胡雪岩很少跟她谈。阿巧姐也只知道，他全家都陷在嘉兴，一时无法团圆，也就不去多想；这时突如其来地听得这一句，心里立刻就乱了。『这是喜事！』她很勉强地笑着说。『喜事倒是喜事，心事也是心事。阿巧，你到底怎么说？』『什么怎么说？』她明知故问。胡雪岩想了一会，语意嗳昧地说∶『我们这样子也不是个长局。』阿巧姐颜色一变，将头低了下去，只见她睫毛闪动，却不知她眼中是何神色？于是，胡雪岩的心也乱了，站起来往床上一倒，望着帐顶发楞。阿巧姐没有说话，但也不是灯下垂泪；放下手中的茶壶，将坐在洋油炉子上的一只瓦罐取了下来，倒出熬得极浓的鸡汤，另外又从洋铁匣子里取出七八片『盐饼干』，盛在瓷碟子里，一起放在梳妆台上。接着便替胡雪岩脱下靴子，套上一双绣花套鞋。按部就班服侍到底，她才开口∶『起来吃吧！』
en: “What is it?” she asked unconsciously in the softest, most coaxing Suzhou dialect. “What is troubling you?” “My mother is coming.” Hu had said little to her about bringing out his family. She knew only that they were all trapped in Jiaxing and that reunion was impossible for the moment; she had thought no further. His sudden announcement threw her into confusion. “That is happy news!” she said, forcing a smile. “Happy, certainly. But it brings worries too. A’qiao, what do you say?” “About what?” She knew perfectly well. After a little thought he said ambiguously, “We cannot go on like this for ever.” Her colour changed and she lowered her head. He could see her lashes moving, but not the expression in her eyes. Now his own thoughts grew confused. He rose, threw himself on the bed and stared vacantly at the canopy. She said nothing, but neither did she weep beneath the lamp. Setting down her teapot, she lifted an earthenware pot from the kerosene stove and poured out some richly simmered chicken broth. From a tin she took seven or eight salted biscuits, arranged them on a porcelain plate and placed both dishes on the dressing table. Then she removed Hu’s boots and slipped embroidered slippers onto his feet. Only after attending to him in proper order did she speak. “Get up and eat.”

zh: 坐在梳妆台畔吃临睡之前的一顿宵夜，本来是胡雪岩每天最惬意的一刻，一面看着阿巧姐卸妆；一面听她用吴侬软语有一搭，没一搭地，说些有趣而不伤脑筋的闲话，自以为是南面王不易之乐。然而这天的心情却有些不同。不过转念之间，还是不肯放弃这份乐趣，从床上一个虎跳似地跳下地来，倒吓了阿巧姐一下。『你这个人！』她白了他一眼，『今朝真有点邪气。』『得乐且乐。』胡雪岩忽然觉得肚子饿得厉害，『还有什么好吃的？』『这个辰光，只有吃干点心。馄饨担、卖湖州粽子茶叶蛋的，都来过了。』阿巧姐问道∶『莫非你在古家没有吃饱？』『根本就没有吃！』『为啥？菜不配胃口？』『七姑奶奶烧的吕宋排翅，又是鱼生，偏偏没口福，吃不下。』『这又是啥道理？』『唉！』胡雪岩摇摇头，『不去说它了。再拿些盐饼干来！』他不说，她也不问，依言照办；然后自己坐下来卸妆，将一把头发握在手里，拿黄杨木梳不断地梳着。房间里静得很，只听见胡雪岩『嘎吱、嘎吱』咬饼干的声音。
en: Sitting at the dressing table for his bedtime supper had always been the most agreeable moment of Hu’s day. As he ate, he watched A’qiao remove her make-up and listened to her soft Wu speech, now a remark, now a pause, full of entertaining trifles that required no thought. He would not have exchanged that pleasure for a throne. Tonight his mood was different. Yet on second thoughts he would not surrender the pleasure, and sprang from the bed like a tiger, giving her a fright. “You!” She cast him a reproachful glance. “You really are behaving strangely tonight.” “Take pleasure while it lasts.” Suddenly he felt ravenously hungry. “What else is there to eat?” “At this hour, only dry refreshments. The wonton seller and the man with Huzhou rice dumplings and tea eggs have already passed.” She asked, “Did you not eat enough at the Gus’?” “I scarcely ate at all.” “Why? Did the dishes not suit you?” “The Seventh Lady made Luzon shark’s fin, and there was raw fish too. Unfortunately I had no luck with such delicacies. I could not eat.” “Why ever not?” “Ah!” He shook his head. “Let us not speak of it. Bring me some more salted biscuits.” He would say no more, and she asked no more. She did as he requested, then sat to remove her make-up. Gathering her hair in one hand, she combed it repeatedly with a boxwood comb. The room was very quiet. Only the crunch of Hu’s biscuits could be heard.

zh: 『老太太哪天到？』阿巧姐突如其来地问。『快了！』胡雪岩说，『不过十天半个月的功夫。』『住在哪里呢？』『还不晓得。』『人都快来了，住的地方还不知道在哪里；不是笑话？』『这两天事情多，还没有功夫去办这件事。等明天刘三爷走了再说。有钱还怕找不到房子？不过——？』怎么？『阿巧姐转脸看着他问∶』怎么不说下去？『』房子该多大多小，可就不知道了。『』这又奇了！多少人住多大的房子，难道你自己算不出来？『『就是多少人算不出来。』胡雪岩看了她一眼，有意转过脸去；其实是在镜子里看她的表情。阿巧姐沉默而又沉着，一副莫测高深的样子。然后，站起来铺床叠被，始终不作一声。『睡吧！』胡雪岩拍拍腰际，肚子里倒饱了，心里空落落地，有点儿上不巴天，下不巴地似的。
en: “When is your mother arriving?” A’qiao suddenly asked. “Soon. In ten days or a fortnight.” “Where will she stay?” “I do not know yet.” “They are nearly here, and you still do not know where they will live? Is that not ridiculous?” “I have been busy these last few days and have had no time to arrange it. I shall see to it after Third Master Liu leaves tomorrow. With money, need one fear being unable to find a house? Only—” “What?” She turned towards him. “Why have you stopped?” “I do not know how large a house it ought to be.” “Stranger still! Surely you can work out how much space you need for the number of people?” “It is the number of people I cannot work out.” Hu glanced at her and deliberately turned away, though he was watching her expression in the mirror. She remained silent and composed, inscrutable. Then she rose and prepared the bed, still without a word. “Let us sleep.” Hu patted his waist. His stomach was full, but his heart felt empty, suspended between heaven and earth with nothing to hold it.

zh: 『你到底有啥心事？爽爽快快地说。牵丝扳藤，惹得人肚肠根痒。』有何心事，以她的聪明机警，熟透人情，哪有不知之理？这样子故意装作不解，自然不是好兆头；胡雪岩在女人面前，不大喜欢用深心，但此时此人，却成了例外，因此以深沉对深沉，笑笑答道∶『心事要慢慢猜才有味道。何必一下子揭破？』阿巧姐无奈其何，赌气不作声；叠好了被，伺候他卸衣上床。然后将一盏洋灯移到红木大床里面的搁几上，捻小了灯芯；让一团朦胧的黄光，隐藏了她脸上的不豫之色。这一静下来，胡雪岩的心思集中了；发觉自己跟阿巧姐之间，只有两条路好走，一条是照现在的样子；再一条就是各奔西东。『你不必胡思乱想。』他不自觉地说∶『等我好好来想个办法。』
en: “What is really troubling you? Say it plainly. All this trailing thread and tangled vine makes one itch with impatience.” How could a woman as clever, alert and worldly as she fail to understand? Her deliberate pretence of ignorance was no good sign. Hu did not usually care to play intricate games with women, but with this woman, at this moment, he made an exception. Meeting reserve with reserve, he smiled. “A hidden thought is more enjoyable if you guess it slowly. Why expose it all at once?” Unable to get through to him, A’qiao fell into offended silence. She finished arranging the quilts and helped him undress and get into bed. Then she moved a foreign lamp to a small stand inside the great rosewood bed and turned down the wick, letting the dim yellow light hide her displeasure. In the stillness, Hu’s thoughts became clear. He saw only two courses open to himself and A’qiao: continue as they were, or part. “Do not torment yourself with fancies,” he said without quite intending to speak aloud. “Let me think of a proper solution.”

zh: 『没头没脑你说的是啥？』『还不是为了你！』胡雪岩说，『住在外面，我太太不答应；住在一起，你又不愿意。那就只好我来动脑筋了。『阿巧姐不作声。她是明白事理的人，知道胡雪岩的难处；但如说体谅他的难处，愿意住在一起，万一相处得不好，下堂求去，不但彼此破了脸，也落个很坏的名声∶』跟一个，散一个。『倒不如此刻狠一狠心，让他去伤脑筋；看结果如何，再作道理。然而抚慰之意不可地。她从被底伸过一只手去，紧紧捏住胡雪岩的左臂，表示领情，也表示倚靠。
en: “What are you talking about, out of the blue like that?” “What else but you? My wife will not allow you to live outside, and you will not live with the family. I must find a way.” A’qiao said nothing. She was reasonable enough to understand his difficulty. But if she yielded out of consideration and agreed to join the household, only to find they could not get on, she would have to leave in disgrace. They would not merely quarrel; she would acquire a bad name: she parted from every man she joined. Better to harden her heart now and leave him to struggle with the problem. She could decide what to do when she saw the result. Yet she must show some tenderness. From beneath the quilt she reached across and clasped his left arm tightly, expressing both her gratitude and her dependence upon him.

zh: 胡雪岩没有什么人可请教，惟有仍旧跟七姑奶奶商量。『七姐，住在一起这个念头，不必去提它了。我想，最好还是照现在这个样子。既然你不肯替我隐瞒，好不好请你替我疏通一下？』『你是说，要我替你去跟婶娘说好话，让你们仍旧在外面住？』『是的！』『难！』七姑奶奶大摇其头，『国有国法，家有家规，婶娘现在当家，她定的规矩又在道理上；连老太太也不便去坏她的规矩，何况我们做晚辈的？』『什么晚辈不晚辈。她比较买你的帐；你替我去求一次情，只此一回，下不为例！』『小爷叔，你还想下不为例？这句话千万不能说，说了她反而生气；喔，已经有两了，还不够，倒又在想第三个了！』『你的话不错，随你怎么说，只要事情办成功就是了。』『事情怕不成功！』七姑奶奶沉吟了好半晌说∶『为小爷叔，我这个钉子也只好硬碰了！不成功，可不能怪我。』『这句话，七姐你多交代的。』胡雪岩说∶『一切拜托，千不念，万不念；我在宁波的那场病，实在亏她。』这是提醒七姑奶奶，进言之际，特别要着重这一点∶阿巧姐有此功劳，应该网开一面，格外优容。其实，他这句话也是多交代的；七姑奶奶当然也考虑过，虽说预备去碰钉子，到底也要有些凭借，庶几成事有万一之望。这个凭借，就是阿巧姐冒险赶到宁波，衣不解带地伺奉汤药之劳。而且，她也决定了入手之处，是从说服刘不才开始。
en: Hu had no one else to consult. Once more he went to the Seventh Lady. “Seventh Sister, there is no need to mention living together. I think it would be best to continue as we are. Since you will not help me conceal it, could you help me gain her consent?” “You mean you want me to plead with your wife and persuade her to let you go on living outside together?” “Yes.” “Difficult!” She shook her head vigorously. “A country has its laws, and a family its rules. Your wife runs the household now, and the rule she has made is reasonable. Even your mother could hardly override it, much less those of us who are her juniors.” “Never mind seniority. She listens to you. Plead for me this once: an exception that will never be repeated.” “Little Uncle, how can you talk of not repeating it? You must never say that. It would only make her angrier: ‘Oh, two are not enough! Now he is thinking about a third!’” “You are right. Say whatever you think best, so long as you succeed.” “I fear I shall not.” After a long silence she added, “For your sake, Little Uncle, I shall have to risk this rebuff. But you must not blame me if I fail.” “There is no need to tell me that, Seventh Sister. I leave everything to you. Whatever else may be forgotten, I owe her so much for nursing me through that illness in Ningbo.” He was reminding her to lay special stress on A’qiao’s service: it justified an exception, an unusual indulgence. Yet his reminder too was unnecessary. The Seventh Lady had already considered it. Even if she expected a rebuff, she needed some ground on which to appeal, however slight the chance of success. That ground was A’qiao’s hazardous journey to Ningbo and her tireless nursing, hardly undressing as she tended him and prepared his medicine. She had also decided where to begin: by persuading Liu Bucai.

zh: 『去年冬天小爷叔运米到杭州，不能进城，转到宁波，生了一场伤寒重症；消息传到上海，我急得六神无主。刘三叔，你想想，那种辰光，宁波又在长毛手里，而且人地生疏，生这一场伤寒病，如何得了？这种病全靠有个体贴的人照应，一点疏忽不得。我跟老古商量，我说只有我去；老古说我去会耽误大事？为啥呢？第一，我的性子急，伺候病人不相宜；第二，虽说大家的交情，已经跟亲人一样，但是我不在乎，怕小爷叔倒反而有顾忌，要茶要水还有些邋邋遢遢的事，不好意思叫我做。病人差不得一点，这样子没有个知心着意，切身体己的人服侍，病是好不了的。』『这话倒也是。』刘不才问道∶『后来是阿巧姐自告奋勇？』『不是！是我央求她的。』七姑奶奶说，『她跟小爷叔虽有过去那一段，不过早已结了。一切都是重起炉灶；只是那把火是我烧起来的。刘三叔，你倒替我想想，我今朝不是也有责任？』『我懂了！没有你当初央求她，就不会有今朝的麻烦。而你央求她，完全是为了救雪岩的命；实际上雪岩那条命，也等于是阿巧姐救下来的。是不是这话？』『对！』七姑奶奶高兴地说，『刘三叔你真是「光棍玲珑心，一点就透」！』
en: “Last winter, when Little Uncle took rice to Hangzhou but could not get into the city, he went on to Ningbo and fell gravely ill with fever. When the news reached Shanghai, I was beside myself. Third Uncle Liu, consider the circumstances: Ningbo was in the Longhairs’ hands, and he was a stranger to both the people and the place. How could he survive such an illness? Everything depended on having someone considerate to care for him. There could be no neglect. I discussed it with Old Gu and said I must go myself. He said my going would only make matters worse. Why? First, I am too impatient to nurse a sick man. Second, though our friendship makes us as close as family, and I myself would not mind, Little Uncle might feel constrained. He would be embarrassed to ask me to bring tea or water or attend to the less pleasant necessities. A patient must not lack anything. Without someone close and devoted, someone who understood his needs as her own, he could not recover.” “That is true,” Liu said. “So A’qiao volunteered?” “No. I begged her to go. She and Little Uncle had once had something between them, but that was long over. Everything had to begin afresh, and I was the one who lit the fire. Third Uncle Liu, consider it for me: do I not bear some responsibility for the present situation?” “I understand. If you had not begged her to go, there would be no difficulty now. Yet you begged her solely to save Xueyan’s life—and in fact it is as good as true that she saved it. Is that what you mean?” “Exactly!” she said delightedly. “Third Uncle Liu, you have a worldly man’s quick understanding. One hint is enough!”

zh: 『七姐！』刘不才正色说道∶『拿这两个理由去说，雪岩夫人极明白事理的人，一定没话好说。不过，她心里是不会舒服的。七姐，你这样「硬吃一注」，犯不犯得着，你倒再想想看！』『多谢你，刘三叔！』七姑奶奶答道∶『为了小爷叔，我没有法子。』『话不是这么说。大家的交情到了这个地步，不必再顾忌对方会不高兴什么的。做这件事，七姐，你要想想，是不是对胡家全家有好处？不是能教雪岩一个人一时的称心如意，就算有了交代！』刘不才的看法很深；七姑奶奶细想一想，憬然不悟。然而她到底跟刘不才不同，一个是胡家的至家，而且住在一起，这家人家有本什么『难念的经』，当然他比她了解得多。因此，七姑奶奶觉得此事要重谈了。『刘三叔，你这句话我要听；我总要为胡家全家好才好。再说，将来大家住在上海，总是内眷往来的时候多；如果胡家婶娘跟我心里有过节，弄得面和心不和，还有啥趣味？只有一层，我还想不明白，这件事要做成功了，难道会害他们一家上下不和睦？』
en: “Seventh Sister,” Liu said gravely, “put those two arguments to Xueyan’s wife and she will have nothing to say against them. She is a thoroughly reasonable woman. But she will not be happy at heart. Is it worth forcing this concession from her? Think it over.” “Thank you, Third Uncle Liu. But for Little Uncle’s sake, I have no choice.” “That is not the way to put it. Our friendship is close enough that we need not fear displeasing one another. In doing this, Seventh Sister, you must ask whether it will benefit the whole Hu family. You cannot regard the matter as settled merely because Xueyan gets his way for the moment.” His view went deeper. Reflecting upon it, she suddenly understood. Yet there was a difference between them. Liu was an intimate of the Hu household and lived with them. Whatever private troubles that family had, he naturally knew far more of them than she did. She felt that they must discuss the matter afresh. “Third Uncle Liu, I must listen to that. I ought to do what is best for the whole family. Besides, once we are all in Shanghai, it will mostly be the women who visit one another. If Mrs Hu harbours a grievance against me and we are only outwardly cordial, where will the pleasure be? There is just one thing I still do not understand. If we arrange this, will it really disturb the harmony of the whole household?”
